name: subhan-skills
description: Personal agent skills, installable on any machine

plugins.name: dispatch-agents
plugins.description: Run one dispatcher tick over a repo's agent pipeline: shepherd agent PRs through checks, codex review and adversarial review, rebase after merges, and dispatch ready issues to background implementers in isolated worktrees.

plugins.name: ship-issue
plugins.description: Take one named GitHub issue end to end in a fresh worktree: plan with opus, stop for approval, implement with sonnet, open a PR, run it through Codex review, and resolve findings with opus — leaving a green PR for the human to merge.

plugins.name: pr-media-upload
plugins.description: Upload a screenshot, GIF or screen recording to a public S3 bucket and get a permanent URL to embed in a GitHub PR description, issue or comment.
